messages:
maria: Quick sync — pricing/packaging change: metering + billing + quota + contract constraints. Can owners call out blockers/ETAs? Need final handoff for Dedicated launch next Friday. cc @ben @clara @erin.

ben: I opened PR 4852 for the metering adapter. Basic wiring done, needs billing adapter integration and e2e tests. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4852

clara: billing adapter team — we're blocked on contract mapping for the fields `enterprise_flat_rate` and `overage_threshold`. Need legal confirmation on billing granularity. If legal signs off today, ETA ~48h to finish integration.

erin.legal: Mapping doc is ready: https://docs.redwood/legal/pricing-mapping.md — see section 2 for field-level semantics. I can approve non-prod mapping now; prod requires contracts sign-off. Pinged @sam.contracts.

sam.contracts: Looping in — we can enable the dev mapping, but prod toggles require an amendment flag in contracts. Suggest we use a feature flag named `pricing_v2_contract_amendment` so rollout is controllable.

ben: That works. For quota enforcement we added a feature flag that's config-driven:
```json
{"features": {"pricing_v2_contract_amendment": false}}
```
We can default to false and flip in prod after contracts signs. Who owns the rollout flip?

frank.sre: SRE can coordinate the flip but we need a runbook + a canary plan. Please add a runbook under /ops/rollouts/PR-4852 and include health checks: latency, token-count distribution, billing-events success rate. Also add an obvious rollback step.

maria: Assigning ownership: Ben -> metering + PR, Clara -> billing adapter integration, Erin/Sam -> contract amendment sign-off, Frank -> rollout ops. Ben, can you add the runbook link to the PR and a basic healthcheck endpoint? :thumbsup:

ben: Yep — will add runbook by EOD. Quick Q: the billing events schema will add a `contract_id` field to metering events; is that acceptable? I'll update the serializer if so.

clara: Yes, `contract_id` is required. Also quota checks must consider `reserved_units` for enterprise plans — sending a short adapter spec now:
```yaml
billing_adapter:
  required_fields:
    - contract_id
    - usage_units
    - reserved_units  # units deducted from quota before overage
  event_type: metering.v2
```

deploy-bot: CI for PR 4852: 7/8 tests passed (one flaky). See https://ci.redwood/builds/4852

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the triage board and add a blockers label if anything stalls. Let's reconvene async tomorrow; call out any new blockers in this thread so we can move the Dedicated launch.
